segments.name: banking
segments.evidence: As resource allocation and performance decisions are not made based on discrete financial information of individual lines of business, the Company considers its current business and operations as a single reportable operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Borrowers pay interest and depositors are paid on balances.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company's operations are managed, and financial performance is evaluated, by our chief operating decision maker on a Company-wide basis.
